FULL_RECORD.meaning: original required semantic value is entirely present with all original decision facts;not itself a durability or PASS assertion
FULL_RECORD.original_duty_satisfied: only for the represented value with verified completeness

BOUNDED_EQUIVALENT.meaning: complete value reconstructed exactly under an approved invertible representation;the representation is finite but not lossy
BOUNDED_EQUIVALENT.predicate: EQ_CODEC or EQ_REF inverse and bindings verified

OPTIONAL_OMITTED.meaning: identified originally optional field omitted with cause/budget/fault effect

REQUIRED_EVIDENCE_MISSING.meaning: required original content absent/overbound/unrecoverable/unconfirmed under applicable duty

flag_semantics.FULL_TEXT_PRESERVED: true only when that entire original text byte stream under declared encoding is preserved;bounded prefix/unrendered=>false
flag_semantics.FULL_EXCEPTION_PRESERVED: true only if all required original exception components are preserved;message-only completeness does not imply full exception completeness
flag_semantics.ORIGINAL_LENGTH: declared original byte stream length if reliably measured;UNKNOWN otherwise;Python character length and retained serialized bytes are distinct
flag_semantics.ORIGINAL_DIGEST_AVAILABLE: true only after complete original bytes have actually been processed;false for partial/normalized/unrendered originals
flag_semantics.ORIGINAL_DIGEST: full original digest with exact declared encoding/kind when available;UNKNOWN otherwise;fragment digests labelled as fragments
flag_semantics.RETAINED_SERIALIZED_BYTES: actual serialized bytes saved for that field/fragment,including appropriateJSON escaping or UTF8 raw log convention
flag_semantics.OMISSION_REASON: explicit field/type/cause and saved range;UNRENDERED differs from a real text prefix
flag_semantics.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE: any lost original mandatory content or unresolved required reference,including protected header/type/errno/origin/cost facts
flag_semantics.ORIGIN_AUDIT_COMPLETE: false whenever a required source object/identity/binding is omitted or unverified
flag_semantics.RESOURCE_LEDGER_COMPLETE: false for missing required fee/ownership facts;unknown actual quantity remainsUNKNOWN,not0
flag_semantics.FINALIZATION_INCOMPLETE: late/unavailable/uncertain required finalization;does not fabricate persistence or observed exit
flag_semantics.FULL_CONTRACT_ACCEPTED: requires actual original task/result/integrity/provenance/resource/persistence/admission conditions;representation approval alone insufficient

EQ_CODEC.equivalence: D(E(v))=canonical(v) bytes,with strict base64,zlib,raw length/hash and canonical JSON validation
EQ_CODEC.proof: For injective valid codec encoding,composition of inverse maps returns the exact agreed byte string. Every decision over decoded content receives identical input. Malformed/partial data is rejected,not mapped to a successful value.

EQ_REF.relation: A particular source/field reference is equivalent iff referenced bytes are exactly available,source digest and locator bind uniquely,and reconstructed canonical field bytes equal the full observed original value.
proof_steps: Let original semantic value be v and canonical bytes J(v).
For proposed source S/hash h/locator l,require available immutable bytes B with H(B)=h.
Define extraction X(B,l) under the declared deterministic locator contract and require J(X(B,l))=J(v),before omitting any duplicate serialization.
Decoder resolves the same B,l,checks required hashes/lengths,and returns X(B,l). Thus decoded canonical bytes equal J(v).
For any authorized decision f over original agreed semantics,f(D(E(v)))=f(v). Identity observations themselves must have been actually made and kept or exactly reconstructed.
Any unavailable/ambiguous/cyclic/unverified reference yields REQUIRED_EVIDENCE_MISSING and full acceptance=false.
restrictions: concrete locator syntax/decoder must be frozen and verified before implementation admission
no replacing observed source identity by an unverified expected value
all dynamic result/count/fee/ownership values must be preserved as actually observed;expected plan is not their original content
no digest-only substitute
all referenced live-run bytes charged in original13 paths;external frozen sources use original permitted read catalogue only

EQ_IDENTITY.relation: exact original identity tuple and binding predicates unchanged;presentation is reversible only
rejected_relations: same digest without required original content or binding
expected identity substituted for unobserved actual identity

contract.L0_priority_rule: strongest original semantic duty dominates all overlapping containers/aliases;group label orcodec layer neverdowngrades facts
rejected_rules: truncated source path accepted as full identity
unverified expected metadata replaces observed identity
known status/errno/authorization consumption fact dropped for budget
original full-content duty discharged merely by honest omission markers

contract.hash_equivalence_limit: SHA256 is an integrity/binding check under inherited trust assumptions. Reference equivalence requires exact original canonical byte equality and the same available immutable bytes;hash equality alone is not treated as mathematical injectivity.

contract_sha256_scope: SHA256 of canonical JSON(contract),sort_keys,compact ensure_ascii,allow_nan=false;not a recursive whole-file hash
